blind_spots.blind_spot: Product markets 'Real-time adaptive streaming for environments of any size' as a mobile-app feature with no acknowledgment of denied/degraded connectivity.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A DDIL site (forward base, contested facility) won't sustain live streaming of a 3D mesh; the same failure mode as the 30fps crowd-detection case — the whole interaction model breaks the moment bandwidth drops.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company's commercial DNA (CRE, airports, schools) built the product around always-on cloud/mobile connectivity; the DoD SBIR work has been facility-digitization pilots, not contested-environment operations.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Real-time adaptive streaming for environments of any size

blind_spots.blind_spot: Zero mention anywhere in their language of ATO/RMF, IL4/IL5, CMMC, or NIST 800-171 despite the product mapping Security Forces Squadron facilities and base infrastructure.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Digitized base security layouts and fire/emergency infrastructure are exactly the kind of data that triggers an ATO/IL4 requirement before it can touch a government network — silence on this means the compliance clock likely hasn't started while the SBIR period of performance is.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team composition described as 'computer vision engineers, programmers, mechanical engineers, commercial real estate entrepreneurs, and veterans of the video game industry' — no compliance/ISSO role represented.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: REscan is made up of computer vision engineers, programmers, mechanical engineers, commercial real estate entrepreneurs, and veterans of the video game industry.

blind_spots.blind_spot: 3D models are described as embedding 'WIFI and GPS signal strength' as a core data layer, with no acknowledgment that GPS is degraded or denied in the exact contested environments Force Protection cares about.
blind_spots.operator_reality: GPS-denied/jammed conditions are standard in the operational spaces REscan is targeting (base perimeters, Security Forces training); a pipeline built around GPS tagging needs a fallback geolocation method that isn't mentioned anywhere.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The GPS/WIFI signal-strength feature reads as a commercial facility-management add-on (asset tracking, IoT) carried over into the government pitch without adaptation.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: The resulting 3D models can also include WIFI and GPS signal strength, the position of IoT sensors in a space

opener_hook: REscan's Patrick SFB Fire Safety SBIR names automated equipment detection but not how the digital twin stays usable if the base network drops. How's it handled today?
what_they_do: SRI spinoff building a helmet-mounted 3D/LiDAR scanner plus AI pipeline that turns large indoor/outdoor spaces into searchable digital twins, sold to commercial real estate and, via three Air Force/Space Force SBIRs, to base fire safety and Security Forces.
